gaps.sentence: The children ___ great fun at the party.
gaps.explanation: have fun / have great fun is the fixed collocation; 'made fun' means mocked someone.

gaps.sentence: If you ___ your word, people will trust you.
gaps.explanation: keep your word means to do what you promised.

gaps.sentence: A true friend will always ___ a secret.
gaps.explanation: keep a secret is the fixed collocation for not telling it to anyone.

gaps.sentence: The company ___ losses of two million last year.
We ___ a taxi from the airport because it was raining.
gaps.explanation: take a taxi/bus/train is the standard collocation for using transport.

gaps.sentence: She has a ___ Scottish accent that is hard to miss.
gaps.explanation: a strong accent is the standard collocation; 'heavy accent' and 'deep accent' are not used.

gaps.sentence: He ___ a speech at the wedding that moved everyone.
gaps.explanation: 'Make a speech' is the collocation; say/tell take different structures.

gaps.sentence: She ___ attention to every detail of the contract.
